metaDescription: Track shipments with your carriers, print labels, and cancel before pickup.

hero.title: Shipments
hero.subtitle: Follow each shipment from pickup through delivery or return. Updates refresh when you open a shipment or return to this page.

table.caption: Shipments list
table.selectAll: Select all printable shipments on this page

detail.metaDescription: Shipment tracking timeline, carrier status, and label actions.

timeline.heading: Tracking timeline
timeline.label: Carrier tracking events
timeline.empty: No tracking events yet. Check again after the carrier reports an update.
timeline.pollHint: Time shown is when we last asked the carrier, not necessarily when the event happened.

empty.title: No shipments yet
empty.description: Book a pending order from Orders to create your first shipment.
empty.searchDescription: Try a different search or filter.

errors.loadFailedHint: Check your connection and try again.

cancel.title: Cancel shipment?
cancel.description: This cancels the booking with the shipping partner and returns order {{number}} to pending.

toast.labelPopupBlocked: Allow pop-ups to open the label PDF
toast.batchMixedConnections: Select shipments from one connection only, or print in separate batches (up to 50 each).
toast.batchEmpty: Select at least one shipment with a printable label.
toast.batchTooMany: You can print up to 50 labels at once.

booking.connectionDescription: Pick which shipping partner account should book this order.
booking.confirmDescription: Review the match and fix any issues before booking.
booking.noConnectionsDescription: Connect and activate a shipping partner before booking.
booking.districtHint: Search the carrier's districts for this governorate.
booking.subscriptionRequired: Renew your subscription to book shipments.
booking.confirmingDescription: The shipping partner is confirming this booking. This usually takes a few minutes.
booking.bookAgainBlocked: Do not book again until we know the outcome.
booking.defaultPickupWarning: Not mapped: collected from this connection's default.

bulkBooking.title: With My Rates
bulkBooking.description: Choose a delivery company for each order, fix any district or box issues, then book them together.
bulkBooking.packagesEditDescription: Change box sizes and weights for this order only.
bulkBooking.packagesEditHint: Each line is one physical box sent to the carrier.
bulkBooking.quotaWarning: You do not have enough allowance for every bookable row. Urgent orders should be first — the rest may be refused.
bulkBooking.bookingInProgress: Booking with your carriers — this can take up to a minute.
bulkBooking.allDone: All rows are booked or removed. You can close this window.

wizard.title: Create shipment
wizard.description: Add the order, then book it with one of your carrier connections.
